properties.name: One dated feature-density illustration only: "93 tools, 28 node types" -> "142 tools, 29 node types, measured 2026-08-02". The skill's method — size a model by contracts and capabilities, never by an LOC ratio — is unchanged. Dated rather than merely corrected, because an undated measurement in prose is exactly what BL-164 is about: it had been silently wrong since the tool count moved.
